definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese confection made from red bean paste, agar, and sugar. Has a firm, jelly-like texture and is typically served in slices.

examples.japanese: お{茶|ちゃ}と{羊羹|ようかん}をいただきました。
{虎屋|とらや}の{羊羹|ようかん}は{有名|ゆうめい}です。
{羊羹|ようかん}は{日持|ひも}ちがするのでお{土産|みやげ}に{良|よ}いです。
examples.english: Yokan keeps well, so it's good as a souvenir.

notes:
{羊羹|ようかん} is a classic Japanese confection.

Types:
- {練|ね}り{羊羹|ようかん} (firm yokan) - most common
- {水|みず}{羊羹|ようかん} (soft/water yokan) - summer treat
- {蒸|む}し{羊羹|ようかん} (steamed yokan)
- {芋|いも}{羊羹|ようかん} (sweet potato yokan)
- {栗|くり}{羊羹|ようかん} (chestnut yokan)

Ingredients:
- {餡子|あんこ} (red bean paste)
- {寒天|かんてん} (agar)
- {砂糖|さとう} (sugar)

Characteristics:
- Long shelf life (especially 練り{羊羹|ようかん})
- Dense, sweet, satisfying
- Pairs well with green tea
- Often a formal gift

Famous brand: {虎屋|とらや} (Toraya) - over 500 years old
